score_semantics: positive supports the proposed repair; negative vetoes the proposed repair

separation_rules.development: may be used for implementation debugging and design
separation_rules.validation: may be used to check a frozen method but must not be used to tune the final threshold
separation_rules.final_test: must remain unopened until the protocol lock is created and checked
separation_rules.retrospective: existing D4V/OFC/GAUGE evidence; never relabel as prospective confirmation

truth_controls.purpose: verify all three decisions rather than only positive detections

placebo.purpose: measure false assertions when the evidence channel carries no discriminating intervention

dose_response.purpose: estimate detection limits and monotonic evidence response

channel_dependence.purpose: test the claimed value of independent interrogation

lock_inputs: method configuration files used by the final run
forbidden_after_final_open: changing the primary threshold in response to final-test labels
dropping failed scenes without a predeclared exclusion reason
changing truth definitions after seeing results

claim_guard: Existing D4V/OFC outputs are normalized only for diagnostic comparability and remain frozen historical evidence.
A prospective publication claim requires new locked validation/final-test records.
Unresolved is a first-class correct outcome when the trial is intentionally non-identifiable.
Real measured confirmation, when available, must be reported separately from synthetic controlled validation.
